patch.explanation: The unique_stg_orders_order_key test failed with 1200 duplicate rows. Raw.orders has 16200 rows but only 15000 distinct order_key values, indicating duplicate order rows in the source. Adding DISTINCT in the staging model removes the duplicates, and try_patch shows all tests now pass.
